summary: Kinross Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Report of Voting Results from its Annual Meeting of Holders of Common Shares held on April 30, 2026. The report covers routine items: election of ten director nominees (all received over 96% votes in favor), appointment of KPMG LLP as auditors (90.49% for), and an advisory vote on executive compensation (92.98% for). No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or management change—is present. This is a standard post-meeting disclosure for a foreign private issuer, analogous to a Form 8-K Item 5.07 filing for US domestic issuers. No deal terms apply.
